headline: Hezbollah Drone Attack Triggers Israeli Retaliation; Hamas Commander Eliminated
subheadline: Israeli Shomron forces destroyed over 30 weapons-production lathes and arrested 10 suspects in Nablus while eliminating Hamas commander al-Qadi in Khan Younis.
lede: Israeli forces are conducting retaliatory operations in southern Lebanon after Hezbollah launched a drone at IDF positions in the security zone, with the IDF calling it a blatant ceasefire violation. The Shomron Brigade destroyed over 30 weapons-production lathes and arrested more than 10 wanted suspects during a counterterrorism operation in the Nablus area. Israeli forces also eliminated Hamas Nukhba company commander Muhammad al-Qadi in Khan Younis, who led the October 7 Sufa outpost raid and held hostages. Meanwhile, Russian forces are pressing territorial advances in eastern Ukraine while ballistic missiles and reactive drones target population centers across multiple oblasts.

sections.title: Russian Drone and Missile Campaign Intensifies
sections.body: Reactive drones were detected across multiple Ukrainian regions including Chernihiv, Kharkiv, and Odesa oblasts, while ballistic missiles targeted Dnipro and Kamianske. Russian forces claim control over Novohryshyn in the Donetsk People's Republic and report advances in the Kharkiv direction. A large ATB warehouse in the Odesa region was destroyed according to Ukrainian intelligence sources, adding to sustained attacks on logistics infrastructure.

sections.title: Israeli Operations Target Hamas and Hezbollah Infrastructure
sections.body: The IDF Shomron Brigade operation in the Nablus area destroyed over 30 weapons-production lathes and arrested more than 10 wanted suspects. Hezbollah fired a drone at Israeli forces in southern Lebanon's security zone, which the IDF intercepted and is responding to as a ceasefire violation. Israeli strikes also hit Nabatieh al-Fawqa and Ain al-Tineh in Lebanon, injuring a Syrian worker and wounding multiple others. The IDF completed clearing Hezbollah's underground facility beneath Ali Taher Ridge in southern Lebanon, with tunnels confirmed cleared of Hezbollah forces.

sections.title: Multi-Front Escalation Signals Conflict Expansion
sections.body: The simultaneous operations across the West Bank, Gaza, Lebanon, and unresolved allegations of Iranian strikes on a U.S. base in Jordan indicate a broadening conflict envelope. Israel's successful degradation of Hamas command structures and Hezbollah tunnel infrastructure contrasts with persistent low-intensity attacks testing Israeli responses. Conflicting narratives on the Jordan base incident create dangerous ambiguity that could trigger miscalculation among involved parties.
